prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong option to put on your shortlist: its Denver-area listing reports a 4.9-star rating across 353+ Google reviews and specifically describes hail-damage inspections, documentation, and repairs. [Gates Enterprises](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d also get a comparison quote from **Ideal Roofing & Solar**, which has customer reviews describing hail-damage work and help navigating insurance claims. [Ideal reviews](https://myidealpros.com/reviews/)

Before hiring, get at least two written estimates, verify the contractor’s current Denver license and insurance, and ask for a detailed scope, warranty, and references for recent local hail jobs. Don’t sign over insurance benefits or rely on a roofer’s promise that a claim will be approved; your insurer makes that decision.
